trap.label: go × come
trap.wrong: My plan did wrong and I go to home.
trap.right: My plan went wrong, and I went home.
trap.why: Em português “deu errado” e “vou pra casa” usam dar e ir. Em inglês, dar errado = go wrong; home dispensa to; e must be/must have been distinguem presente e passado.

fix.wrong: We went to home after class.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com dedução (presente): “I am sure she is at home.”
Reescreva com dedução (passado): “I am sure he was at home.”
rewrite.answer: He must have been at home.
